title: paracraft rule promotion record
description: records the evidence and harness witness that promoted a profile constraint from drafted to active. a constraint becomes active only after cross-checking against a minimum of two independent sources (or one source plus a direct partner answer) and reproducing its threshold in the benchmark harness.

promotion_id.description: stable identifier for this promotion record

constraint_id.description: the constraint being activated, must match a constraint in the named profile

profile_version.description: the profile version in which the constraint becomes active

property.description: the constraint property name, for readability

evidence_ids.description: minimum two independent evidence ids that cross-check the threshold. one may be a direct partner answer if recorded as evidence.

benchmark_models.description: manifest model ids whose harness verdicts reproduce the threshold (fires below it, passes at or above it)

harness_report_sha256.description: sha256 of benchmarks/report.json from the harness run that witnessed the verdicts

harness_image_digest.description: docker image digest recorded in that harness run

notes.description: human-readable rationale for the promotion; cite any resolution of contradictions
